entry.name: MAV_MERIO_NAVIGATION_MODE_STANDALONE
entry.description: Use internal computation without GPS/external navigation.

entry.name: MAV_MERIO_NAVIGATION_MODE_EXTERNAL
entry.description: Use external navigation data; do not compute RPY internally. When using EXTERNAL navigation mode, to work properly, gimbal must receive with at least 10Hz values for: • RPY (Roll, Pitch, Yaw), • LLH (Latitude, Longitude, Altitude).

entry.name: MAV_MERIO_NAVIGATION_MODE_INTERNAL
entry.description: Use inner IMU for navigation computation. When using INTERNAL navigation mode, to work properly, gimbal must receive with at least 1Hz values below: • VELNED (Velocity North, East, Down),• LLH,• HEADING.

When set, the velocity command is divided by the zoom ratio.
